planner_policy.cpu_rate: maximum of completed CPU rates and separately labeled right-censored timeout lower bounds after the configured timeout safety factor
planner_policy.frame_coverage: maximum technically completed selected physical frames only; timeout target coverage is retained but never counted complete
planner_policy.memory: maximum observed RSS with a planner safety factor

provenance_path_policy: Private source paths, scheduler identifiers, and hostnames are retained only in the separately hash-pinned internal catalog.
